_comment: WITHRBAC-STRUCT-001 — routes where the handler may operate on a company withRBAC did not authorize. A route may be listed ONLY with a recorded reason and an owning follow-up item; anything not listed fails CI. This is a findings ledger, not an exemption list: entries are expected to be removed by fixing the route, never grown to silence the guard.

accepted.reason: POST reads req.body.companyId and passes it to fillOpportunitySlots (generator + upsert) and listActiveOpportunities. withRBAC prefers req.query.companyId, so ?companyId=<own> with body {companyId:<victim>} authorizes one company and operates on another. Discovered by this guard during WITHRBAC-STRUCT-001 and deliberately NOT fixed here: the task that found it is an implementation task, and expanding it into a security fix would ship an unaudited change.
accepted.severity: HIGH — cross-tenant write (opportunity generation/upsert) plus read
